notes: Track of Meitav's child-savings investment provident fund (regulator classification "קופת גמל להשקעה - חסכון לילד"), the kupat gemel lehashkaa side of the National Insurance "חיסכון לכל ילד" programme. cma_fund_id is null: no Meitav document read gives the parent fund number. The reports page and the regulator's name write "סיכון מוגבר"; the kid page writes "סיכון גבוה" and marks it the default for a parent who did not choose a track; the regulator's sub-specialization is "סיכון גבוה".
